name: uclimate
description: μClimate: weather along your driving route

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 4200
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.check: cd backend && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run mypy app tests && cd ../client && npm run typecheck
